descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Turn your room into a battlefield and defend it in mixed reality

In Xploit ZERO, digital enemies invade your real-world space. Your room becomes the map, and every corner counts.

Xploit ZERO is a mixed reality arcade tower-defense game where your real room becomes the battlefield. Place turrets anywhere in your environment, react in real time, and fight off waves of enemies trying to overwhelm your defenses. Move, aim, and adapt as the pressure increases. Survival depends on your strategy.

# 🏠 Your room becomes the map
Play directly in your real environment using Mixed Reality (MR).

# ⚔️ Place turrets anywhere
Collect **Memory Cores** to build your defense strategy.

#  👾 Fight incoming waves
Enemies attack from multiple directions, stay alert.
# ⚡ Physical interaction
Use your hands to build, place, and control your defenses, and engage in first-person combat against flying enemies.
# ⌛Fast-paced gameplay
React quickly and adapt your strategy in real time as the pressure increases.
# 🎮 Game Modes
**Countdown Mode**  
A fast-paced **5-minute countdown** designed for intense arcade sessions.

**Endless Mode**  
Survive as long as possible and chase high scores under constant pressure.

# 💬 Early Access & Community
Xploit ZERO is available in **Early Access** with **5 fully playable levels**, offering a complete experience from day one. Follow Xploit ZERO on social media and join us as we push innovation forward.

# ℹ️ Play Space 
To enjoy a better experience, make sure you have at least 8 ft x 8 ft (2.5 m x 2.5 m) of play space.
